title: Caldera private deploy — weekly sync scratchpad
content:
Caldera private deployment — weekly sync (scratchpad)
Owner: Ettore Martins
Week of: 2026-03-09 sync prep / follow-up notes
Attendees (planned): Maya, Omar, Rhea, customer infra lead (Anika), me
Meeting time: Tue 10:30 PT (30m) — focus: unblock network + certs, validate canary rollout plan

Objectives for this sync:
- Re-check network MTU workarounds and S3/MinIO throughput regression.
- Confirm KMS/HSM policy alignment and test decrypt path end-to-end.
- Validate private registry certificate import into air-gapped cluster (Harbor proxy).
- Lock down the canary rollout % and fallback policy for model-serving images.

Quick status (one-liners):
- Networking: MTU mismatch suspected; large artifact uploads fail at 6–8 MiB/s with intermittent TCP resets. Customer environment uses MTU=9000 on distribution switch, nodes default to 1500.
- Storage: MinIO on dedicated nodegroup: RGW error spikes during parallel PUTs. Possibly related to MTU + conntrack.
- Registry: Customer uses offline Harbor; cert chain missing intermediate -> kubelet rejects image pull in init-containers.
- KMS/HSM: HSM vendor returned updated policy template; customer needs us to sign-off before rotating keys.
- Observability: Token-level billing not available in private run; we need to surface token counts per route in local console (placeholder feature request).

Milestones / timeline (high level):
- Network validation & fix: target 2026-03-12 (test harness + two controlled customer uploads).
- Registry cert reconciliation: 2026-03-11 (push patch to bootstrap script).
- KMS policy sign-off + test rotation: 2026-03-16 (coord with CS + security).
- Canary rollout for model v2: start 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC (3% -> 10% -> 50% over 48 hrs)

Open blockers (detailed):
1) MTU mismatch causing upload failures (critical)
   - Symptoms: large uploads time out or reset after ~30s under parallel PUTs; tcpdump shows MSS/fragment differences.
   - Owner: Omar Patel
   - Next action: run controlled upload tests from bastion -> minio (script: tools/net-mtu-check.sh). Collect pcap and MB/s numbers. Due: 2026-03-11 EOD.
   - Notes: ask customer whether jumbo frames used on all switches; if not, suggest standardizing to 1500 or enabling fragmentation on edge.

2) Harbor offline registry cert chain (high)
   - Symptoms: kubelet errors "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority" for init container pulls; image pull secrets fine.
   - Owner: Maya Chen
   - Next action: add intermediate CA to nodes' trust store via bootstrap-config map; craft short-lived patch to init script to install /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/caldera-intermediate.crt and run update-ca-certificates. PR: linked above. Due: 2026-03-11 morning.
   - Customer ask: they want certificate pinned in air-gapped vault; need to coordinate with network team to import fingerprint into their provisioning pipeline.

3) KMS/HSM policy mismatch for rotation (medium)
   - Symptoms: test rotation fails with permission denied for encrypt/decrypt after key rotation in staging HSM. Root cause: missing allow-listing for the cluster service account in vendor policy template.
   - Owner: Rhea Singh
   - Next action: review vendor template changes and provide an annotated dif. Schedule 30m call with customer's security ops. Ticket: CAL-1234. Due: 2026-03-16.

4) Observability gap: token-level chargeback (low but customer wants roadmap)
   - Owner: Ettore (me) / Product-Console
   - Next action: prepare short one-pager explaining limitations + workaround (route tagging + local usage-export). Draft due: 2026-03-14.

Decisions required before next sync:
- Can we accept a temporary node-label workaround (label nodes with 'caldera-no-jumbo') or do we need to force infra change? (decision: recommend temp label + long-term infra alignment).
- Canary rollout: confirm 3% starting traffic is acceptable to customer for initial stability checks.

Customer action items to push (I'll nudge during sync):
- Confirm switch configs and MTU on all leaf/aggregation ports by 2026-03-11. Point of contact: Anika (customer).
- Provide HSM service account ARN & allowed IP ranges for policy by 2026-03-13.
- Ship intermediate cert bundle to the bootstrap bucket (SCP/airgap instructions provided).

Runbook snippet (for Maya/Omar) - registry cert patch step-by-step:
1) Copy intermediate cert to bootstrap host: scp caldera-intermediate.crt bootstrap:/tmp/
2) SSH to bootstrap host, move to /etc/ssl/localcerts/, chmod 644
3) Append to /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ and run: update-ca-certificates --fresh
4) Recreate node image or trigger DaemonSet to inject cert into /etc/ssl/certs on nodes (helper: scripts/propagate-ca.sh)
5) Validate by curling registry over https from a node: curl -v https://harbor.caldera.local/v2/_catalog
Notes: need fallback plan if nodes are immutable (we'll use kubelet-proxy sidecar injection).

Risk register (short):
- If node images are immutable and we cannot inject CA quickly, deploy a pull-through proxy in an isolated subnet (extra ops time: ~8–12 hrs).
- Conntrack exhaustion possibility under heavy upload concurrency — may require sysctl tuning (net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max) and scaling minio nodegroup.

Questions for Eng Lead (to bring up in weekly):
- Can SRE provide a lightweight conntrack dashboard we can enable for this customer? (cost: minor, ops: moderate)
- Is there appetite to add a "private-consumer" flag to bootstrap that will auto-add supplied intermediate certs to base image? (product ask)

Agenda for the next customer call (15–20 min):
- Quick status (5m) — MTU test results (Omar)
- Registry cert plan + bootstrap patch ETA (Maya) (5m)
- KMS policy sign-off timeline (Rhea) and next steps (3m)
- Agree on canary start and rollback criteria + confirm date (2–3m)

Personal TODOs (notes-to-self):
- Draft the product one-pager for token-level export + workaround. Keep it <1 page, include timeline for potential feature. (Due 3/14)
- Prep short escalation email template to send to support if uploads fail post-MTU fix; include attachment list (pcap, netstat, dmesg).
- Add CONFLUENCE link to runbook and make sure PR references it before merging.

Loose ideas / brainstorming (non-blocking):
- Could we use a replicated NFS cache in front of MinIO to reduce concurrent PUTs when customers are on flaky L2? Probably too heavyweight but worth an eval for other customers.
- Add a "cert-import" CLI flag to the bootstrap container that reads from a mounted dir and runs update-ca-certificates at node init. Low-effort, high payoff.

Raw notes log (for quick copy into meeting):
- 10:00 AM — collected tcpdump from bastion showing MSS 8972 on switch vs 1460 on node -> fragmentation flagged.
- 11:20 AM — MinIO pod OOMKilled during 64-parallel PUT test (investigate memory profile).
- 14:30 PM — customer sent HSM policy template; missing 'Decrypt' action for service-account.

Wrap-up: focus this week on network test + registry patch. If both land by Thu morning we can proceed with canary as planned next Wed. Escalate to SRE if conntrack or OOM patterns persist after initial mitigation.

-- Ettore
